page.layout: One scanned page: the front board of a bound volume, blind-stamped with an ornamental cartouche in the centre; no printed text. A small label or ink mark on the spine edge at the right is not printed text.
page.notes: Binding cover (leather or vellum board) with a blind-tooled ornamental panel and an oval central medallion. No printed words, page numbers, running heads or signatures. The faint letter-like mark on the spine at upper right is handwriting or a label, not transcribed.
